reviews.text:
Got charged 250 just for vitals at CityVet and came here and spent 210 for a checkup and blood check and got my baby medicine and as soon as I get home he’s eating.

Update I’ve been here a couple times and each time the Office ladies are rude and don’t know how to desensitize if you’re already upset because of your cat obviously. They’re just rude and offputting are I called right now to see if I can bring my cat in in 15 minutes before close, but y’all are at the hospital so I shouldn’t even annoy you. And she was saying “well if you bring him before we close yeah but Then you would have to take him to our other hospital”  Without saying there would be an emergency charge.
The staff has been really friendly,  patient with my questions, caring towards my pets, and provided follow up to tests quite promptly.

NEVER GO HERE! Jeannie Is the worst person you will ever meet. I got my first cat here and everything went smoothly. My application was still active so I decided I wanted another kitten for my first to play with. I went and found a kitten that was perfect, I put my name down for her and was the first since they had just gotten her the day before. Jeannie Said that once she gained weight, was healthier, and spayed she would be ready to go home. Over the next month I visited her every week and we were told that she was almost ready to be taken home. Once we were told she was ready we were told to text Jeannie what day we would want to pick her up. When we did that she told me I was “no longer a good fit” and that she already had another family lined up. Jeannie’s assumptions were completely unfounded especially because I use their vet for my first cat! So they know I’m a good owner. After letting me visit for a WHOLE MONTH she decided last second I wasn’t getting her. She argued over text about it and even tried to tell me to come back and find another cat, as if I would EVER go back there or give them any more money. I immediately got my first cats records and took them to another vet. DO NOT WASTE TOUR TIME HERE!!! Jeannie is an awful person that lets the power go to her head.
Had the best experience here. Sam was so kind, knowledgeable, and patient with us and helped find the perfect kitten. Thank you Sam!!
Extremely helpful and patient staff. I appreciate that they take time to double check things before giving you an answer instead of brushing things off

The boarding facility for cats is completely unorganized and dirty. No one seems to know what’s going on there. Everyone tells you something different every time you speak to someone .  There’s no clear communication on anything. They were calling me at almost 9pm the night before my overseas flight to try to get records that they already told me they would get themselves. Mind you I made this reservation a month prior and they waited till the night before boarding to do this so right before my trip it put me into a really stressful situation and they kept even emailing me after I dropped my cat off while I was boarding my plane asking for a signature that they forgot to get. The place smells so bad there’s litter boxes that look like they havent been changed in days. When I finally came to pick my cat up, they couldn’t find his belongings for almost an hour And the girl that works at the desk, kept calling my male cat a “she” the whole time even though I corrected her multiple times she still called him a she which normally isn’t that big of a deal but it was making me think she was confusing him with another cat because everything was SO UNORGANIZED. They also charged me for certain tests that they did not tell me about beforehand. I only found out about them when I went to pay
I trust East Lake Cat Care center for all of my boarding needs.  I will be returning in the future when it is time for annual exams and vaccines.

Immensely grateful for the care provided to one of our foster kittens on a Sunday afternoon. We were squeezed in within 20 minutes of arrival and all procedures were discussed with transparent pricing before approval.

We arrived with a queasy, lethargic, dehydrated, trembling kitten, and within 15 minutes of getting him back home, he was hungry, peppy and playful again.

We took our cat, Stevie Rae Cat, in this week(January 2026) for a "Tune Up and Oil Change" and then took her out to the race track where she ran a 100 yard dash in 8.5 seconds, a Cat record in D/FW! :).
Kidding aside they are everything you expect in a Vet and have never disappointed.
Hats off to Dr.Hille, Dr. Grant, Kate Wagner, Dr. Fling,  and all the courteous Doctors and Staff at East Lake.
Thanks, ELCCC for keeping Stevie in great shape and perfectly healthy!
East Lake Does Really Care about your Pet and continues to be the Best Little Cat House in Texas and also The U.S.
They are are a First Class Vet and have been and will always be our Vet Of Choice.
They wanted to board my 3 cats for $700 per night just because 2 of them had missed a couple of vaccines. They did not stay there. This is terrible!!!!!

I had a very disappointing experience at this clinic. When I called to inquire about the cost of a cat exam, I was told it would be $75. Based on that information, I decided to bring my cat in. However, during the visit, the doctor administered a couple injections without explaining how much they would cost.

At checkout, the receptionist informed me that the exam fee would be waived as a welcome gesture for new clients, but I was then charged $235 for the procedures performed on my cat. I was completely surprised by the unexpected charges and found the lack of communication about costs to be unprofessional and misleading.

I really liked this vet.. My cat got really sick and needed surgery, I called a couple places and they quoted me well over 5k for the surgery and not including so many other things. I called here early in the day and spoke to a lady at the front desk who was extremely helpful, she was super kind and understanding. She assisted me in explaining what I would need, how much it would be and then quickly assisted me in scheduling an appointment same day ! The price here compared to the other places was amazing.

I took my cat and she was seen shortly after i arrived, the vet was Dr. Crouch ( I apologize if misspelled ) and they were amazing. Not only did they explain everything, they cared for my cat, they gave me an estimate and made me feel very comfortable!

I called a few times to check and although it may have took a second to reach them they answered me as fast as they could, explained everything and remained patient with me as I was freaking out most of the time since I left my cat there for surgery and for a couple hours after.

I really think this place will be my preferred veterinary facility for taking my babies. Staff was great , place looked lovely, and prices were good !😊
Caring professionals delivering quality service.

Thank you to Dr. Crouch, and the staff of East Lake Cat Care Center.  For taking care of Spike and his Dental today.

Great job on catching dental issues early.

I never give reviews, but this one did deserve one. Was recommended this center by my friend who has raved about how great the service is. Although this is all the way in North Dallas from where I live, my cat was having health issues and I wanted to give her the best care since she’s little and had a hard transition in environment. The house is so cute and welcoming and the pet hotel was adorable. Initially, the vet I was working with was very great and answered all my questions and concerns, I knew the initial cost was going to be expensive so I set aside money for it.

However, the next time I came in was just for shots and fecal test sample, then from a 3 minute conversation with a new vet that I wasn’t expecting I was charged with a $60-$70 fee for a vet consultation. I was not expecting this charge at all as it was just a routine appointment from what scheduled and a different vet than I initially had. But I paid it still and that day the test came back inclusive on the second part and they had to send it to a “parasite specialist.” This is where things went downhill.

From there was told I would be called for an updated but I did not receive a call and I’m always on my phone for work and check all my voicemails. A week and half of no response and my cat is still in this limbo and during that time I AM the one calling, emailing and trying to get answers. They just assumed she had the parasite with 2 different from desk people I talked to and wanted me to just drive over “pick up the medicine” when I explained over and over again how I was waiting for the parasite special to confirm it was the same parasite or something different… and since the medicine did not work the first time I had to be sure as it was getting expensive and the distance driving there was getting inconvenient.

Finally I get a direct call from the vet herself who confirmed that it is the same parasite and they will have the medicine ready along with another type of medicine for her too. So, when I drove over there, to their credit Diane is very sweet and understood how frustrating these past few weeks have been and had the medicine ready and although I had to go to the other location to grab the other half of the medicine they had it ready for me so I could not wait around.

However, i still had requests that were not fulfilled since I’ve been there that were in my email. Which was my cats records that I need. So I confirmed with front desk before I left the email address as I have these emails all unanswered and she said she sent them the request. I’ve been asking since June and it’s now July for the updated records. My friend who recommended this spot said she emailed for records for her cats and always got them promptly. At this point it is very unprofessional and the fact that I’ve been having to pursue this Vet Center for answers, spending all this money, driving all these distance, and no email back is very telling.

Truly liked this place before and because of the inconsistencies, very disappointed and may have to take my services elsewhere.

Update: after calling them again and emailing for the records I have received them. Thank you. Will now be using the records to unfortunately go to another vet as this was a very difficult situation.

I genuinely love everyone here.

I've been in and out of the cat care center near constantly for the last couple years, dealing with my kitty’s flagrant disregard for his limited nine lives, and the vets never leave me worried we won't find a solution. They are also incredibly kind about answering all my questions and explaining things over again until I understand what's happened and what the game plan is for my cat’s treatments. All the rest of the staff here as well, Janelle, Adrienna, Catherine, everyone, are so friendly and accommodating, and if there's ever any problems I know someone will be on top of it quick.

A couple months ago my cat had a 3 night stay at the main center as well, for kidney issues, and they had no problem letting me come and see him for well over an hour in their back room every day, they never made me feel in the way or over staying myself, and my high strung little boy was perfectly okay the entire time, so I know they treated him right.

Honestly, 10/10 place to bring you animals, everyone there is 100% committed to the health of their patients and the satisfaction of their owners.

I adopted both my cats from here and I love the cat care center it’s warm and inviting and always made the visits better for my babies. I would give them 5 stars but I’d recommend finding one doctor and staying with them there as changing can lead to inconsistent diagnoses or care, but would really recommend and for cats the environment is everything!

We are incredibly disappointed in East Lake Cat Care Center. After going here for years and sending many friends and family here, we decided to board two cats for a few days while having to go out of town, as one had many medications she needed. She was supposed to receive one pill, a syringe medication, and subcutaneous fluids during her stay, some of which daily. When we went to pick the cats up, she was covered in her own urine, we were told this happened several days ago by one of the techs. The medication sheet was not filled out. We were told that she did not receive the subcutaneous fluids at all, despite us telling them about them multiple times, and this vet having been the prescriber. There were more pills than there should have been in the bottle, and the syringe meds were not as empty as they should have been. Additionally, there was very little food or water left out for the cats. She was 8lbs going in and 6lbs leaving just a few days later. Our other cat went in at 18lbs and left at 16.5lbs. We spent months trying to get in contact, both in person and on the phone, with a manager or anyone to make this right, while her health continued to deteriorate. She was happy and active going in and could barely walk after.

She died shortly after this visit. We received no sympathy from East Lake Cat Care Center and never heard back from management. They still charged us well over $1000 for medical boarding.
I am not quite sure what is going on here. I have a called a couple times and every person has sounded dismissive, and vaguely annoyed with my questions. …

Brought my kitten in for ringworm and have to say I’m pleased with my experience. This is my first cat and frankly my very first vet visit ever and it was pleasant. They were super kind and knowledgeable and gave me options when it came to …

BEST!!! My cats always freaked out when they had to wait in the same area as dogs, listen to them bark, etc. EL's cats-only center is awesome! Was already impressed w/Dr. Miller's care when my girl got a bladder infection. Am incredibly …

Were very friendly, helpful and patient. Went out of their way to help me even when I was a bit in crisis. I have full confidence they will take great care of the kitty I left them, and will find her a purrfect home! (Yes I know the pun is lame let me be lame)
The care they show to my senior cat (and to me, when I am crying in the waiting area lol) is unmatched. I truly appreciate every nurse, admin, vet, and volunteer who works at East Lake
